title: Zelenskyy to meet with U.S. envoy as tensions with Trump mount
summary_full: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is set to meet with U.S. special envoys on Tuesday after President Donald Trump aimed fresh criticism at the wartime leader.
